recipes.name: Rocket Salad with Balsamic Dressing and Shaved Parmesan
ingredients: 15g / 0.5oz parmesan (, shaved finely using vegetable peeler)
instructions: Place rocket in a bowl, drizzle with Dressing then toss.
Transfer to serving bowl. Shave over parmesan. Serve immediately.

page_recipe_notes: Recipe Notes: Balsamic Glaze Option: Just drizzle rocket with extra virgin olive oil, sprinkle with a pinch of salt and pepper. Toss. Then drizzle with about 2 tsp balsamic glaze. Transfer to serving bowl, shave over parmesan. This version has great little intense pops of flavour against the fresh rocket!
